questions.question: In Asaph's psalm, God summons the heavens above and the earth. What does He call them in for?

answers.text: So He can judge His people
So He can build His temple
So He can make them new

questions.question: Since the whole world already belongs to God, what kind of offering does He tell His people to sacrifice to Him?

answers.text: A gift of gold and silver

questions.question: God kept silent while the wicked did evil. What does God say the wicked thought about Him?

answers.text: That He was just like them

questions.question: In Asaph's psalm, what does God promise to show the person who rightly orders his way?

answers.text: A long life in the land
